evidence.snippet: // Validate state (simple check for presence; full implementation would verify against stored state)
evidence.why: State parameter is only checked for presence, never compared against a value generated/stored at flow start, so CSRF/state binding is not actually validated.

evidence.snippet: body: JSON.stringify({ code, client_id: OAUTH_CONFIG.clientId, redirect_uri: OAUTH_CONFIG.redirectUri, grant_type: 'authorization_code' })
evidence.why: Token exchange sends no code_verifier/PKCE parameter, so the OAuth code exchange runs without PKCE as described in the rubric's vulnerable criteria.
